fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job?

Are you an active member of the online Crypto world? Do you love chatting to people about all the new coins and what interesting comments Elon just tweeted? Then you might just be what we are looking for!

Here at RDX Works (formally Radix DLT), we are looking for a Community Liaison to join us and be the champion of the RDX Discord and Telegram communities. You will be a leader in these channels, a friend to all whilst also playing a firm-but-fair moderator. You will also be an advocate for the community by directing the Marketing team in what people are passionate about, as well as ensuring the community is heard by the wider RDX team.

You can talk to the hodlers, you can back up the buidlr’s, you know your coins from your tokens and you meme like no one's business. Crypto-lingo is your jam, you are a fast learner and can ELI5 to anyone anytime!

What do you need?

  • You have worked in or been a very active member in a Crypto community
  • Be based in the region or be prepared to work APAC hours
  • You are familiar with the culture of the general crypto user and associated demographics
  • You have experience in moderating, posting on and advertising on social media platforms
  • You must be comfortable with platforms such as Telegram, Discord and Reddit
  • You understand and can balance being welcoming and helpful while ensuring the RDX community remains a constructive and enjoyable forum
  • You are eager to learn the intricacies of RDX, what it means to be a layer-1 DeFi protocol, and continue to build your knowledge of a complex project to help engage and support our community
  • You are someone who has mastered the ability to not only directly engage within community channels, but be a catalyst for additional engagement and conversations within it
  • You have exceptional written English communication to a native/fluent level
  • You are able to effectively manage your time between multiple channels and effectively manage a range of suggestions, feedback, and support within community channels
  • You are familiar with navigating around sensitive topics, as well as ensuring a balance between aiding the community and remaining inline with regulatory and legal requirements

Who are we?

At RDX Works (formally Radix DLT), we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

RDX went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

In return for working with us, you get to work remotely on your own schedule (or the option to get a local co-working space if preferred), work at the cutting edge of new technology and benefit from an education budget to use to further develop your skills!

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply directly here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.
